uiFindings017: Session list staleness right after restart: /api/session/list initially returned only the UI-created live session; a store change forced re-enumeration and all 3 sessions (blank + both team roots) appeared, stable afterwards. The team roots ARE listed (cold, full projections).
The sidebar tree puts sessions that are not members of any workspace into the collapsed 'Ungrouped' bucket (rows not rendered until the bucket row is expanded) — team roots sit there by default.
No session deep links exist in 0.1.7 (/?session=, /?sessionId=, /session/<id>, /#/<id>, /#session= all ignored; URL stays '/').

Composer-stuck-after-veto (the key nuance for gate-5): a page that experienced the ordinary-open veto keeps its client session object in the failed-resume state ('Session unavailable', composer disabled) even after the server-side Team takeover succeeds — the takeover does not re-point that page's session view. A page that attaches AFTER the takeover shows the composer ENABLED (normal placeholder 'Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions'), and re-opening the session row on the stuck page re-attaches (no reload, no new veto — attaching to a live session produces zero activation events). Run 6's driver handles this: on the stuck state it re-opens the row (legitimate navigation, NOT a reload) and proceeds.
